transcript.text: Good evening. I need to conduct the routine pre-publication check before I can publish tonight's facility-duty roster. We have three positions to fill: radio desk from 1800 to 2200, key-control desk from 2200 to 0200, and one overnight alternate covering both. Our available personnel are Sgt. Hale, Cpl. Ortiz, and Spc. Vance. The radio desk requires the unit radio-console qualification, and the key-control desk requires current key-control certification. I need the personnel-readiness NCO and the security NCO to report any qualification or availability updates before I release the roster. Please go ahead.
